source_note: New prospective synthetic experimental design, NOT a rerun of historical T15/T17 or independent clinical validation
primary_question: Does a typed cost-aware SAFER decision policy improve budget-constrained evidence-compatible risk resolution versus a strong typed-action-enabled comparator at identical synthetic information and costs?
endpoint: Target-patient population mean binary loss of a frozen synthetic predictor (clinical-reference estimand simulated, not observed clinical adjudication)

mixture_estimation.method: simultaneous Hoeffding box plus simplex; never use latent true mixture inside any policy

loss_inference.method: predeclared time-uniform Hoeffding strata, bounded patient-level Bernoulli losses
loss_inference.k_rule: K equals the number of eligible prespecified conditional streams; allocate union bound across all possible streams before runs

A1.description: One next independently sampled patient loss from an eligible prespecified stratum stream

A2.description: Once-per-stratum independent target-reference discrepancy audit, consisting of 120 paired weak/reference observations; derive one-shot upper discrepancy bound using delta_c and multiplicity correction; no assumed successful repair

A3.description: Once-per-unsupported-stratum access to an independent target-site source with verified direct-target patient sampling and clinical reference, opening a valid A1 stream; A3 grants access only, not a free risk certificate

budget_includes: A1, A2, A3 and shared warm-start labels; common unlabeled target pilot excluded and separately reported

randomization.method: common-random-number patient streams per world/seed; independent target mixture sample; independent A2 reference pairs

all_policies_share: same loss and reference potential-outcome streams
no_policy_access_to: clinical NIH Test or post-hoc outcomes
information_fairness.condition: P0-P3 use the same evidence-compatibility/structural gates but allocation-only contrasts are primary only on W1/W2/W5; they cannot be used as the sole benchmark for typed-repair superiority on W3/W4

policy_specification_requirements.P4: Manuscript Algorithm 2/Eq.(16) with deterministic NON-ORACLE surrogate: for each legal A1 batch, assume its 20 unseen Bernoulli losses have Beta(1,1)-smoothed current stratum mean (or 0.5 if no data), update only n and plug-in mean, recompute frozen Hoeffding bound and robust U; utility=max(0,U_now-U_pred)/20. For A2, use a world-independent Beta(1,1) mismatch prior and a prespecified one-shot Hoeffding upper discrepancy proxy for n_ref=120 and delta_c/multiplicity; no future label or world risk access. For A3, plan using a two-step A3-plus-next-20-valid-A1 lookahead with Beta(1,1) prior mean 0.5 for a newly accessible stratum; divide positive predicted change by 370. If A1-only structural floor exceeds alpha, only repair actions that could remove a blocked reason are legally eligible; if none affordable, report STRUCTURAL BLOCK. A1 actions remain possible under ordinary UNRESOLVED state. Prediction is planning-only; actual inference uses observed data and valid intervals. Tie-break A1, then A2, then A3; lowest stratum index.
policy_specification_requirements.P5: Repair-first comparator using exactly same validity tests, A2/A3 access, budgets and prices: when any structurally blocked stratum exists, choose affordable A2 first for the lowest-index reference-blocked stratum, otherwise A3 for lowest-index unsupported stratum; do not spend A1 while B_A1>alpha. After repairs, allocate A1 batches with smoothed plug-in Neyman based on w_hat * sqrt(max(p_hat*(1-p_hat),0.01)); ties lowest stratum. If repairs unaffordable, STRUCTURAL BLOCK; no hidden oracle weights or outcomes.
policy_specification_requirements.tie_break: A1 then A2 then A3; within type lowest stratum index; same rule all replicates
policy_specification_requirements.neyman_initial_variance: Beta(1,1) posterior mean and Bernoulli variance; variance floor 0.01 before sqrt
policy_specification_requirements.cost_evaluation: A2/A3 are synthetic prices only, compare total cost, not clinical currency

primary_comparison.binary_endpoint: Valid correct resolution (CERTIFY when true risk <= alpha; HIGH_RISK when true risk > alpha), provided every required compatibility gate was valid at decision time
primary_comparison.effect: paired difference in resolution rate (candidate minus baseline) averaged equally across W3 and W4

statistical_analysis.pilot_ci: percentile bootstrap 2000 draws of paired episode-level differences with independent resampling of seeds within world
statistical_analysis.confirmatory_ci: paired bootstrap 5000 draws using fixed seeds; no seed selection
statistical_analysis.multiplicity: one registered primary contrast; all other comparisons descriptive and labeled secondary
statistical_analysis.report: all seeds, negative results, uncertainty and counts; zero events not interpreted as uniform proof

pilot_decisions.GO_to_confirmation: No gate breach or invalid CERTIFY; exact code/spec conformance PASS; primary paired improvement >= 0.05 and bootstrap pilot lower 90% CI > 0 at budget 2600; CPU time within cap.
pilot_decisions.REPOSITION_without_confirmation: No defensible 5 pp advantage or improvement not robust, or newly defined policy cannot be differentiated from baselines; report full negative pilot and pivot to assumption-aware auditing.
pilot_decisions.STOP_and_debug: Any structurally invalid CERTIFY, holdout leakage, non-representative stream, policy oracle leakage, duplicated patient units, code/spec mismatch or broken reproducibility; at most one documented correction cycle before re-freezing as a new version.

publication_gate: Synthetic-only results, even if positive, cannot be described as external hospital validation, clinical certification, proof of deployment safety, or real adjudication cost saving
implementation_gate: 02C may not execute any experimental seed until P4/P5 faithful versioned implementations and source-stream/reference/support assumptions pass preflight and unit tests. Code missing at time of 02B design freeze.

reference_discrepancy_rule.applied_after_A2: upper_e=min(1, observed_reference_disagreement_fraction + sqrt(log(2*d/delta_c)/(2*120))) where d is total number of prespecified strata in the world and A2 occurs no more than once in each
reference_discrepancy_rule.reference_sampling: independent target-patient paired weak and reference outcomes, with no outcome-based selection

conditional_loss_rule.eligible_K: total prespecified strata, including stratum currently unsupported, fixed before trials
conditional_loss_rule.tau_k: zero ONLY for source/target conditionals equal by synthetic generator assumption OR direct-target A3 stream
conditional_loss_rule.n0: initial 20 representative patient labels from each initially supported source stratum; charged to total cost
conditional_loss_rule.adaptive_sampling: separate independent stratum patient sequences and outcome-blind within-stratum acquisition
